title: Outstanding Result in the NZ Physics and Maths Competition
body: A great result for Rosehill College in this year’s **NZ Physics and Maths Competition**. On 9 May, nine of our students took on Round 1 of the nationwide competition, testing their problem-solving skills against students from across Aotearoa. A special congratulations to **Shubhkeerat Kaur Brar (Year 11)**, who achieved a **100% score**, placing **1st equal in the Year 9–11 category** and in the **top 1% nationally**. This result earned Shubhkeerat a place in **Round 2**, which was held on 13 July. Well done to Shubhkeerat and to all nine students who represented Rosehill College. It is great to see our students taking on challenges like this and competing at a national level. View the Round 1 results
